# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 2.x.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| 1.x.x   | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability within the **SUDEEPBOTS Module Renamer** engine, please report it privately:

1. Contact via Telegram: [@SUDEEPBOTS](https://t.me/SUDEEPBOTS)
2. Submit a Private Security Advisory via GitHub repository security tab.

Please do not open public issues for sensitive security vulnerabilities. We will review and patch critical reports promptly.
